The obligations of Consultant as set forth herein, other than Consultant's obligations to perform the Project, shall survive the termination of Consultant's engagement with Aduro. If any provision of this Agreement is found to be illegal or unenforceable, the other provisions of this Agreement shall remain effective and enforceable to the greatest extent permitted by law. This Agreement shall not be assignable by Consultant.

summary: Sponsor must pay fees in installments as specified.
quote: The fee for the placements and other rights provided under this Agreement for the Initial Term (as defined below) is * * * is payable within * * * of the date of this Agreement, with the balance of such fee payable by Sponsor in * * * consecutive equal installments of * * * payable by the * * * of the Initial Term commencing * * * following * * * the Launch Date (as defined below).

summary: North agrees to make one voice-over appearance during the term at North's personal residence or another mutually agreed location.
quote: If requested by Company, North shall make one (1) voice over appearance during the Term. The voice over appearance shall take place at North's personal residence or at another mutually agreed upon location in Wisconsin, and shall not exceed two (2) hours in duration.

summary: Neither party may assign the agreement without the other's consent, except in certain circumstances.
quote:
Neither party may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the other party's written consent, which consent will not be unreasonably withheld, except that: (a) a party's rights and obligation hereunder may be transferred to a successor of all or substantially all of the

business and assets of the party regardless of how the transaction or series of related transactions is structured, provided, that the successor party agrees to be bound by all of the terms and conditions of this Agreement; and (b) Sponsor may assign its rights and obligations under this Agreement to any entity (i) which operates the Sponsor Website and (ii) which agrees to bound by all of the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

summary: Talent must keep confidential any non-public information about ESSI, including stock, new products, and corporate actions.
quote: Talent agrees, to, at all times, keep in strict confidence any information he may come across that is not yet public, including, but not limited to, information about ESSI's stock, new products, acquisitions, and/or any other corporate action the Company may take, or has taken.

summary: Customer must follow the backup process provided by EIT.
quote: The Customer commits to follow the backup process that EIT has provided for him.

summary: Review engineering changes and report implications to Customer within two working days.
quote: Contractor will review the engineering change and report to Customer within two (2) working days of any implications of the proposed changes. The report should include all possible implications on materials, delivery schedule, manufacturing process, quality and product cost and shall also quote the Contractors costs for implementing the changes.

summary: Customer must select security options on Order Forms.
quote: Customer acknowledges that IBM offers numerous security options, specified in Service Option Attachments. Customer is responsible for selecting on Order Forms the set of security options that it determines meet Customer's needs.

summary: Parties are free to enter into similar agreements with others.
quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.

summary: Pey Dirt retains all rights not specifically granted to Company.
quote:
All rights not herein specifically

granted to Company shall remain the property of Pey Dirt to be used in any manner Pey Dirt deems appropriate.
